label: DEVELOPMENT_ONLY_NOT_QUALIFICATION
raw: One inference per window. Decode A and B from the identical onset/frame array objects, hash and journal concatenated raw float32 tensors. B performs zero additional inference.
LayerA: Exact exposed v6 18 jobs/228 windows, production source adapter/FIR/source runtime and exact frozen model-input SHA gates. No source reselection or audio decode.
LayerB: EXPOSED_CANONICAL_PCM_BROAD_COMPARISON_NOT_DEVICE_RATE_QUALIFICATION. Exact 50 Phase9G takes, identical canonical 16k inputs for both models. Common interior start=max(historical start,1050), end=min(historical end,duration-170). Production window planner, all real samples.

pacing.rule: Freeze from exposed physical source coordinates only. Initial READY at max(frozen scenario arm, real preroll-ready). Ordinary multi-gesture epochs rearm at next physical onset minus the existing 150ms eligibility lead, never before actual captured-through. Final retirement at exact source end. Pitches, candidate output and expected verdict never select timing.
pacing.delivery: Frozen v7 append/drain physical capture endpoints, exact publication order, no event-time rewrite. H50 closes only after owned analysis frontier covers its end. Verdict enters POST_VERDICT, stays locked until the frozen epoch rearm. Never rearm backward; missed epoch is reported and blocks a mandatory positive, not repaired.
pacing.busyLate: Historical rapid/busy/late scenarios remain diagnostic only; no requirement to recognize a second physical strike while non-READY. Their old empirical denominators are NOT_EVALUABLE, never PASS and not survivor gates. New non-ready isolation is separately mandatory.
pacing.lastEpoch: No output-dependent extra retry epoch or rolling event bag. Every selected physical opportunity has fixed source-event scope; later publications may complete an already open H50 interval but cannot open outside it.

product: Actual V13 schema5 StepPracticeRuntime; exact attack-pitch-set equality; one attempt; only READY opens; POST_VERDICT blocks; MATCH advancement/final completion only at explicit rearm; strict event > watermark; equality ignored; no queue or reuse. No v9 product scorer/WaitingTopologyGate imported.
truthAttribution: Nearest fixed physical gesture within <=100ms, independent of target; equal-distance ambiguity blocks evaluation. MATCH physical support requires exact complete pitch set and physical source time > attempt eligibility boundary.
isolation: Mandatory deterministic actual-runtime tests for CAPTURING outside current H, ANALYZING, POST_VERDICT, late old source time, equality and old target after rearm. No observation ownership reuse.
broadMetrics: Exact xc1_scientific_bakeoff.score_take 50ms same-pitch maximum-cardinality/min-error matching. Onset precision/recall/F1, FP/min, timing count/median/p95/max, macro deltas from Robust A. STEP chord completeness/verdict agreement/strike-set acceptance NOT_COMPARABLE.
catastrophicRule: Preregistered structural catastrophe only: zero matched onsets across all 50 nonempty truth takes, or nonfinite/invalid metric/output accounting. No unsupported post-hoc delta threshold. All broad deltas are reported descriptively, not an automatic winner score.
survivor: Challenger only. Static/StageA/blindness/one-owner/session/no-fallback/integrity PASS; all repair and mandatory positive sequences exact at both LayerA rates; zero dangerous negative/full-truth/reuse regressions; NON_READY_INPUT_ISOLATION PASS; complete LayerB metrics without preregistered structural catastrophe.
parity: LayerA Robust A exact historical v7 comparable source domain/window/observation identity/order/pitch/midiPitch/sourceEventSample/targetSample/confidence. Exclude only runtime wall-clock/availability diagnostics. No tolerance.
stop: Any pre-neural failure stops with zero inference. Post-freeze no tooling/threshold/geometry/H/scorer/corpus edits. Runtime failure seals partial evidence, no retries. Parity/freeze/seal/unknown-run failure blocks entire evaluation. No third candidate.
latency: REPLAY_ENGINEERING_DIAGNOSTIC_NOT_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_UX_LATENCY. No source/performance.now offset fit and no shipping UX threshold.
